previousContract.meaning: Preserves the v2 chance, state, replay and destiny projection fixtures; this version adds only auction action and observation fixtures.

source.meaning: Frozen product source for adapter fixtures only; not a balance or release verdict.

scope.game: original solo four-seat finite extensive-form game
scope.auctionDecision: One compound sealed submission at the start of the auction input phase for each living seat.
scope.simultaneousCommitments: Each seat's observation omits every opponent's uncommitted or sealed bids until the original engine reveal.
scope.knownFutureInformation: Only the next-market preview and next event/rule that the current UI shows to this seat are included; the rest of nextMarket is excluded.

fixtures.proves: The lazy iterator emits integer bid amounts, types, curse intents/targets, fees, contribution amounts, max-bid limits and shared budget bounds for the original sealed auction input.
fixtures.doesNotProve: A complete action tree for earlier/later decision phases or a solved extensive-form model.

fixtures.proves: The iterator enumerates every non-empty eligible market subset with the shared stake, original type cap, one-fee budget reservation and at-most-one-win settlement semantics.
fixtures.doesNotProve: All game actions, arbitrary transition boundaries, or cross-night continuation.

fixtures.proves: The auction projection includes this seat's private bag/destiny and UI-visible state while omitting opponent bag contents, unrevealed bids, RNG state and unshown future market entries; hidden recorded destiny reveals are filtered by the pinned replay projection.
fixtures.doesNotProve: Information equivalence at non-auction decisions, complete observation histories, or server-grade secrecy.

fixtures.proves: The auction-only key distinguishes this seat's own prior observed decisions and submissions.
fixtures.doesNotProve: Full recall across omitted phases or a complete information-set key for the game.

nextEngineeringDeliverable.name: complete phase transitions and observation-action history for every seat
requirements: Enumerate mark, event, sacrifice, shrine-pick, battle and settlement choices at their actual boundaries.
Add a hidden commitment/advance interface without revealing earlier sealed submissions.
Connect every observation and own action into a full-recall history and prove observation equivalence against the original UI/policy context.
Continue binding fixtures to the pinned product source and compare every adapter transition with the original engine.

gate.blockingReason: Auction-only actions and observations are partial. Other decision phases, complete chance support, cross-night restore, canonicalization, full recall, complete policy enumeration, terminal/payoff mapping and independent solver review remain incomplete.
